description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode I (Noctis - Fire)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lucian King Mode I (Noctis - Fire)
